variableReadSpelling: VARIABLE-READ SPELLING (php, 2026-10-11). The `uses` targets in this file that name a `$variable` are BINDINGS, not declaration names: the analyzer spells a variable read as `<read source>\u0000<binding>` with `metadata.localBinding`, because a local/param/superglobal is never a published symbol and the BARE name let the store bind the read to an unrelated same-named declaration in another file. The defect and its counterfactual are in validation/m14/fixtures/php/local-read-phantom.mts; the whole-population effect is in docs/analyzers/history/php-lane-notes.md. What each row PINS (which read, from where, and how many) did not move.
rationale: First PHP review wave: PHP-A receiver reads, PHP-H static reads, PHP-D const fetches, PHP-E tear-offs, PHP-F interpolation, PHP-B subscript bases, PHP-C closure captures, PHP-O1 trait uses (oracle hole). Every pin probe-verified against both the analyzer and derivePhpEdges before pinning; lanes confirm the pair agrees on corpora.

expectRelationships.comment: PHP-O1, relabelled 2026-10-23 (R3, no grammar change): a trait composition is `mixes_in`, not a value read — the `uses` row this pin used to assert was the ten failing to spell the construct honestly. 1:1 relabel, so this row's source/target are the same edges; the `uses` class loses exactly this row and nothing else moves.
